content_sections.heading: TMC Ad-hoc Medical Officer Vacancy Details 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Ad-hoc Medical Officer (Plastic Surgery): M.Ch. /D.N.B. (Plastic Surgery) or equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by National Medical Commission. Minimum 1 year experience in Onco-reconstruction and Microvascular Surgery either during M.Ch training or Post M.Ch.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years Age relaxation will be as per government rules. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.text: Rs. 1,40,000/- (Nil exp) to Rs. 1,52,000/- (3+ years) Per Month

content_sections.heading: TMC Ad-hoc Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC Ad-hoc Medical Officer (Plastic Surgery) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this TMC recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the post of Ad-hoc Medical Officer (Plastic Surgery) at Tata Memorial Centre.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Ad-hoc Medical Officer (Plastic Surgery) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online resume?
faq.answer: The deadline for submitting the online resume is 24 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted on 26 August 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for the Ad-hoc Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Ch. /D.N.B. (Plastic Surgery) or an equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by the National Medical Commission, along with at least 1 year of experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates is 45 years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this role?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 1,40,000/- to Rs. 1,52,000/- per month, depending on experience.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, at the address specified in the official notification.
